source:
@@U04695@@
(In the middle region.)

@@U04696@@
What is that wisp of cloud in the pine trees? Do I guess aright? A host of infant souls?

@@U04698@@
Tell us, Father, where we're drifting, good one, tell us who we are. We're happy here. Being is gentle.

@@U04700@@
Innocents, babes born at midnight, mind and senses barely roused, lost at once to grieving parents, delightful gain to angelic hosts! You sense a loving soul here present. Come, draw near, obey your feeling, you fortunate few to whom Earth’s harshness is spared, who bear no earthly traces. Come, descend, come into me, enter my eyes and see the world, use them as your own. Do come.

@@U04701@@
(He takes them into himself.)

@@U04702@@
Those are trees. And these are rocks. And there a mighty stream flows downward, shortening its steep descent.
translation:
@@U04695@@
（在中间区域。）

@@U04696@@
松树上那一缕云是什么？我猜对了吗？一群婴儿灵魂？

@@U04698@@
告诉我们，父亲，我们正在漂流到哪里，好人，告诉我们我们是谁。我们在这里很开心。存在是温柔的。

@@U04700@@
无辜者，半夜出生的婴儿，心智和感官几乎没有苏醒，立即失去了悲伤的父母，天使般的主人却获得了令人愉快的收获！你感觉到这里有一个充满爱的灵魂。来吧，走近一点，听从你的感觉，你们这些幸运的少数人，没有遭受地球的严酷考验，没有留下任何尘世的痕迹。来吧，下降，进入我的世界，进入我的眼睛，看世界，把它们当作你自己的。来吧。

@@U04701@@
（他把它们纳入自己的内心。）

@@U04702@@
那些是树。这些都是岩石。那里有一股汹涌的溪流向下流动，缩短了陡峭的下坡时间。
